lines.t: The city fades when the shadow falls
I hear my breath in the empty halls
Hands on my chest like a steady flame
Still you know me when I cannot say your name I've been walking through the afterglow
A tired soul in the undertow Everything loud but my heart stays still
Waiting on mercy and a broken will And I don't have words, only this ache
But you are here, even in the wait
Hold me in the silence of the Sabbath
When my strength runs low and my faith is shattered
I feel lost but I'm not abandoned
You are close in the quiet I can't understand
Lay me down in the piece of your shadow
Where the dark can't touch what your love has gathered
I'm not whole but I'm held in the cracks
Breathe on my soul in the silence
In the silence of the Sabbath In the silence of the Sabbath
Midnight leans in like a heavy rain Every old wound saying I'm not the same
But there's a stillness under all this pain Like a holy whisper calling me again
If I've been wandering through a valley blind
You're the shepherd walking right behind
No, I don't see far, but I trust your hand
Even in the dark, I can barely stand
And I don't need light to know you're near
Your love is enough to pull me
Hold me in the silence of the Sabbath
When my strength runs low and my faith is shattered
I feel lost but I'm not abandoned
You were close in the quiet I can't understand
Lay me down in the piece of your shadow
Where the dark can't touch what your love has gathered
I'm not whole but I'm held in the cracks
Breathe on my soul in the silence of the Sabbath
So let the night fall soft
Let the noise all fade away
I was made to rest in you
Not to carry every weight
If my tears are all I'll bring
Still you call it an offering
In the hurt, in the way
Oh God, you remain
Hold me in the silence
Of the Sabbath
But my strength runs low
And my faith is shattered
I feel lost
But I'm not abandoned
You were close in the quiet
I can't understand
Lay me down
In the peace of your shadow
Where the dark can't touch
What your love has gathered
I'm not whole
But I'm held in the cracks
Leave all my soul
In the silence of the Sabbath
In the silence, you stay
In the dark, you remain
I am held, I am held
By the God of the Sabbath
